test_title: PYST 41: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following correctly differentiates between absolute poverty and relative poverty?

options.text: Absolute poverty is based on income inequality; relative poverty is not.
Absolute poverty uses a fixed threshold; relative poverty compares individuals within a society.
Absolute poverty is subjective; relative poverty is objective.
There is no difference between the two.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Absolute poverty uses a fixed threshold; relative poverty compares individuals within a society.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Absolute poverty** refers to a condition where individuals lack the basic necessities of life such as food, clothing, and shelter. It is measured using a **fixed threshold**, such as the international poverty line defined by the **World Bank**, which is currently set at **$2.15 per person per day** (as of 2022).
